earlierFailures.conclusion: 17 pass, 1 WebKit failure: native error property preceded the queued error event. Poll the exact single notification within the existing deadline; installed full rerun and source WebKit rerun pass. Source full run predates this wait-only change and its exact test bytes are separately hashed.
12 Chromium failures: wrong test expectation that final center was red. FFmpeg proves all centers blue.
12 Chromium failures: comparing unobscured source image with overlaid progress time tooltip. Final raster comparison excludes lower 30px and rounded border; mean RGB limit stays 3.
2 pass, 1 failure: core 5.4.0 calls revokeObjectURL with empty previous source once per initialization. Final test asserts exactly two empty revocations and exact nonempty ownership.

33 pass, 3 Firefox failures in recovered tool at delay=20: only indices 0,4,8 have blue centers, others black. Frozen runtime draws after timer without awaiting seeked. Final historical combination uses original delay=300; candidate still exercises delay=20. This does not claim old short-delay extraction passes.

remaining: Windows WebKit 26.6 native Blob MP4 error 4; HTTP loads. Actual Safari file extraction and physical device evidence missing.
